item.title: Corridor ~Meikairou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Picori
  • 発売日: 1999-05-27
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: Corridor ～迷回廊～
  • 英語名: Corridor Meikairou

あらすじ

Rumina never new her father and her mother suddenly passed away. On the dying bed her mother gave her a note with a name on it, so having nowhere else to go Rumina came to this mysterious person in search of shelter. She was allowed to get inside. But this new family has a lot of dark secrets that she will have to face now.
